verdict.rationale: React ships its own build-time React Compiler, which automatically optimizes components and removes the need for manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo. It can be adopted incrementally and safely skips code that breaks the Rules of React. Separately, React's runtime updates the screen to match new data, so developers never write diffing code. However, the evidence shows the compiler only automates memoization on top of runtime reconciliation; nothing shows it compiles components into surgical, fine-grained DOM operations. Missing for 10: evidence the compiler emits direct/surgical DOM updates rather than memoized re-renders, independent or hands-on corroboration of performance gains.
